title: August and the Witness
author: Orsen Eriksen
blurb: Jonah Sandoval, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent fifteen years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the trial begins.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
